name: ai_marketing_claude_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the ai_marketing_claude capability.

prompts.name: website_audit_prompt
prompts.template: Audit the website at {website_url} and generate a detailed report on SEO, UX, content quality, and competitor comparison.
prompts.use_case: Marketing agencies needing automated, comprehensive campaign planning and execution

prompts.name: copy_generation_prompt
prompts.template: Generate marketing copy focused on {marketing_objective} for {target_audience} using this style: {copy_requirements}.
prompts.use_case: Businesses performing competitor analysis and website audits to improve marketing strategies

prompts.name: email_sequence_prompt
prompts.template: Create an email sequence of {email_count} emails with tone {tone} targeted at {target_audience} for the campaign objective: {marketing_objective}.
prompts.use_case: Content creators generating multi-channel marketing content rapidly

prompts.name: ad_campaign_prompt
prompts.template: Design an ad campaign plan with budget {budget} and platforms {platforms} focused on {marketing_objective}.
prompts.use_case: Email marketers designing complex drip campaigns with AI assistance

prompts.name: content_calendar_prompt
prompts.template: Generate a content calendar for {period} focusing on topics: {topics} with publishing frequency {frequency}.
prompts.use_case: Consultants preparing professional marketing reports for clients

prompts.name: competitive_intelligence_prompt
prompts.template: Analyze competitors {competitive_intel_targets} and provide insights on their marketing strategies.
